notes.title: Ver0.731
notes.content:
1. Optimized the display of the spaceship UI and adjusted the position of some text.
2. Fixed some issues with the fleet system save files and optimized the display of the angular shields.
3. Optimized the method for determining the attachment of multiple objects when editing the spaceship, making it easier to maintain the original state during spaceship assembly.
4. Changed the module selection UI to a list-based UI, replaced the circular UI with a functional selection UI; added support for box selection, multiple selection, copy, paste, and undo functions in spaceship editing; enabled loading or saving of spaceships during long-range navigation mode spaceship editing.
5. Refined the calculation method for assessing spaceship combat power and increased the initialization speed of different species cores.
6. Added various forms of core modules and expanded the corresponding technology tree.
7. Introduced the "Boundary Breakthrough" technology, allowing the enhancement of the strength limit of spaceship assembly using certain resources.
8. Added module resistance attributes to impede the penetration damage of invasive weapons.
9. Optimized the behavior patterns of cannon modules, fixed the issue where laser cutting beams could not merge with cannons to form cutting nets.
10. Added collision functionality to the Binding Light Phantom Thunder and allowed for destruction.
11. In detailed testing mode, the current trigger body's data display will show energy consumption, cooldown time, impact points, etc.
12. Added two types of close-range weapons exclusive to plant technology and expanded the corresponding technology tree.

notes.title: Ver0.729~0.730
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840719/fbe9a2345759e28f56a35cfc1650951e23c1a7ee.png
1. In the basic ship editing mode, a template function has been added. Pressing the middle mouse button (pressing down the right joystick) will open the template menu, allowing you to load or save template files. Further optimization of the module coloring in quick edit mode allows for continuous coloring by continuous clicking; there is now a limit on the length of input when saving files.
2. Added stargate function in Voyage mode, allowing for star map teleportation at stargates with low costs; increased costs for star map teleportation at space station; changed from 2 permanent space stations to 1 permanent space station + 1 stargate, sometimes only having a stargate; optimized space station interactions, allowing players to remain near the space station when entering ship editing or technology unlock interfaces.
3. Added various small celestial bodies in Voyage mode, with darker colors for gaseous small celestial bodies.
4. Increased presence of regular fleets in star systems, changed fleet behavior patterns, allowing players to trade with fleets.
5. Players are now allowed to edit their own escort ships.
6. Expanded the scale of star systems, making the distance to the center of a new star system closer upon entry; optimized space station positions to ensure they do not extend beyond the current star system range.
7. Added symmetric triangular ship hulls.
8. Optimized backgrounds, reducing the flicker frequency of star clusters.
9. Enhanced the behavior patterns of some insect modules, increasing the maneuverability of insects.
10. Fixed issues where triggers may not recognize the crystal reinforcement status of some modules.
11. Adjusted font colors in some UI menus to enhance contrast; modified the ship status UI to display a more intuitive ship damage status in the bottom left corner.
12. Added several standard missions.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840719/1099731dcb9deab2d74515205076e33f0538388c.png

notes.title: Ver 0.728
notes.content:
1. Add a detailed testing mode to the spaceship editing mode, which will test the trigger and display detailed information about the weapon.
2. Add alien space stations in long-range mode; Technology unlocking will be divided into native technology and foreign technology, and foreign technology unlocking requires unlocking in a foreign space station.
3. In the long-distance mode, the spacecraft is subject to intensity restrictions, and the intensity gradually increases according to the unlocking degree of technology. If the intensity limit is exceeded when editing the spacecraft, it cannot be saved.
When operating the joystick, change the LT/RT to lock the target, and control the steering with the right joystick.
5. Long press and right-click on the spaceship editing interface to display more spaceship module information. All special modules are supported.
In long-range mode, planets and stars shrink by nearly a hundred times, and some planets generate numerous satellite defenses.
7. The trigger will limit the number of trigger modules, and the limit requirements for the number of different triggers are different.
8. Add 2 buttons and modify the configuration of keyboard, mouse, and joystick buttons, as well as modify the configuration of most functional operations.
9. The spaceship editor has optimized the UI, and the color menu now allows HSV color adjustment and adjusts the operation modes of the mouse and controller separately; The mode switching can be displayed on the module menu; When saving the spaceship, the keyboard and mouse can directly input the spaceship name, and support upper and lower case writing. The controller continues the virtual keyboard operation; The spaceship editing is divided into two editing modes, basic editing mode and quick editing mode.
The basic editing mode is basically the same as the old editing mode.
In quick editing mode, left click (LS) to create modules and attach them, and right click (RS) to directly fill in colors.
10. UI adjustment in remote mode, displaying spacecraft information and status in the lower left corner and spacecraft radar in the upper right corner.
11. ESC menu adds selection of movement mode and motion blur switch.
The default movement mode is absolute movement mode. In this mode, when controlling the spacecraft, it moves in the world coordinate system. ↑ moves upwards, ↓ moves downwards, ← moves to the left, and → moves to the right.
In relative movement mode, the spacecraft moves in the direction of its local coordinate system. If ↑, the spacecraft advances; if ↓, the spacecraft retreats; if ←, the spacecraft moves to the left; if →, the spacecraft moves to the right.
12. Adjusted the display mode of most of the UI, no longer dynamically moving or zooming with the camera.
13. In the long-distance mode, a star map function has been added. When transmitting through the space station, star maps are used for selection and transmission, which requires a certain amount of cost.
14. Fixed the issue where the trigger could not obtain the crystal gain effect of some modules, and fixed the problem where the spacecraft was not successfully changed when entering the editing interface after changing the spacecraft.

notes.title: Version 0.727 Emergency Patch
notes.content:
1. Add 12 small celestial bodies to enrich the map; some small celestial bodies will drop corresponding items when destroyed; some small celestial bodies will only appear in specific types of areas.
2. Most insect modules can operate without being controlled by a mothership; the acid range of the Ambushing Beetle is increased by 100%; the energy burst requirement for the Energy-sucking Beetle is reduced by 20%; the explosion range of the Suicide Bee is increased by 100%; the maximum attack range of the Electric Bug is increased by 33%.
3. Optimize the nebulae and stars in the background to reduce resource consumption; reduce the brightness inside stars.
4. Increase the collection probability of some item props and fix the issue of no collection bonus in the Decayed Insect Domain.
5. Press and hold the right mouse button in the ship editing interface to display more ship module information; currently, only some modules will be displayed; changes in in-game currency when entering ship editing in Long-haul mode will be settled uniformly after exiting the interface; fix the issue that may replace a player's ship with a test ship; fix the issue of unidentified modules.
6. Add 2 types of reconnaissance modules, one prioritizing locking onto ships and the other prioritizing small targets; no longer lock onto objects beyond the attack range.
7. Modify the calculation method of area damage, making it easier to detect and calculate area damage, but the overall limit is changed to base damage × 2. Correct the base damage and range of ship energy module detonation.
8. Reduce the base damage bonus of area damage weapons by 20-30% for the Enlargement module.
9. Thunder modules will cause additional damage to exposed ship hulls.
10. Fix the issue of being unable to engage in long-distance navigation.
11. When entering the backpack or store, continuous clicking can be used for continuous purchase, use, sell, or discard; fix the issue of a purchase option for items with a quantity of 0 appearing in the store.

notes.title: Ver0.726 Patch Update
notes.content:
1. Increased the coordinate display on the large map, with the button response time on the large map reduced to 0.25 seconds.
2. Increased the refresh rate of the small celestial bodies and ships on the map by 60%.
3. Optimized the planet generation function in the star system, initially generating images of 256×256, and later generating standard images of 2048×2048 after some time to display faster on the map.
4. When piloting a ship, the current ship status will be displayed in the upper right corner.
5. Reduced the refresh rate of unmanned planets by 50%.
6. Added 2 neutral factions.
7. Expanded the capacity of the ESC main menu and optimized some operations in the main menu.
8. Planets will no longer have docking functions; when approaching, they will automatically connect to the planet channel and allow negotiation. Negotiations will no longer change the field of view, and hostile planets will also allow free trade and ship assembly. The increase in friendliness gained when purchasing supplies from a faction has been enhanced.
9. Added a UI icon for the activation of the hyper-pulse engine.
10. Added permanent space stations; two space stations will automatically refresh when players enter each celestial system.
11. Optimized AI command in battle mode, making it more proactive in occupying unmanned fortresses and optimizing ship AI routes.
12. The ship purchase interface now allows mouse-click operations.
13. Fixed a bug that allowed unlimited harvesting during certain time periods.
14. Added interactive effects triggered subsequently by the impact beam module and the lightning beam module.

notes.title: Demo更新2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840719/278fcd22e223febe975e500a954bf44a9f604a1f.png
更新内容：
1.The new game mode is "Campaign Mode".

In campaign mode, you will appear in a system generated "solar system" and generate several planets. You will receive one of these planets (and your enemies will also receive it).


Each planet will create a certain amount of Coin for the corresponding team, which can be used to build spaceships to protect the planet or attack enemy planets. Select the spaceship with the left mouse button, and right-click on a location on the screen to direct the selected spaceship to the corresponding location.


When the spacecraft is over a hostile planet, it will slowly occupy that planet. If you haven't occupied any planet and don't have a spaceship, you will lose this game.


2.Add 2 types of automatic counterattack turrets

Self Sight Guard Cannon: Quickly fires bullets and automatically attacks all nearby hostile targets (including bullets).


Self aiming light cannon: automatically locks on surrounding hostile targets (including bullets), fires a laser attack, and can intercept high-speed hostile missiles.


3.Weapon system updates

Adjust the laser cutting module so that when the laser is applied to a "cannon" type weapon, it will become a laser mesh (up to 8 lasers), causing a certain amount of damage before disappearing.


Adjust the light particle module so that when applied to a "cannon" type weapon, the cannon can achieve a "collision rebound" effect.


Add a gain module - target pointing module: it can enable bullets to actively aim at the current mouse position.


More weapons content will be officially launched in the official version.


This update is currently here, please stay tuned.
If you have any good suggestions, please email them to 1317193145@qq.com I will carefully review and make the necessary modifications. Thank you. Due to the fact that the game is only created by me, the updates are relatively slow. Please forgive me.

notes.title: Demo Update 1
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840719/25e8f9e00f8dbd735e497e5a5408828aafcaf40c.gif
Update：
1.Optimize the collision system of the game and increase the frame rate stability system during battles. When the game stutters, the game will automatically slow down to stabilize the frame rate (try to stabilize it at 24 frames or more)

2.Optimize the inheritance function of the weapon system, as shown in the figure, to continue generating multiple segments of laser after the laser forks.

3.Add 4 modules for weapon systems, 1 gain type module, and 3 directional connection modules.

Gain type module - Target pointing module: can make bullets actively face the current target position (aiming position).


Directional connection module: It can make the module connection more directional, without the need to connect in all four directions as before. The module can be connected in two directions up and down, two directions up and right, and three directions up, down and right. The editing of weapon systems has become more flexible.


4.Add a simple tutorial feature to the spacecraft editing system.

This update is temporarily over, and a new mode will be updated next. Stay tuned.
If you have any good suggestions, please email them to 1317193145@qq.com I will carefully review and make the necessary modifications. Thank you.
Due to the fact that the game is only created by me, the updates are relatively slow. Please forgive me.
